lines.say: One's in terracotta, by a bright window.
The other is in plastic, in a dim kitchen.
I'm Sprout. I work out each plant's care from where it actually lives.
And I tell you when a plant is in the wrong light.
Move it somewhere brighter, and its care moves with it.
A hot, dry week coming? I'll offer to water sooner. You decide.
I'll warn you which plants could hurt the cat.
And when a leaf turns yellow, I'll help you find out why.
Free, with no account. And your plants stay on your phone.
Sprout Evergreen. Free on Google Play.
